name: Main Ridge Dairy
address: 289-295 Main Creek Rd, Main Ridge VIC 3928
signature: A working goat dairy with farm-made cheeses, seasonal sharing plates and cheese grazing boards at Billies.
editorNote:
Main Ridge Dairy makes cheeses from the milk of its own goat herd. At Billies, the seasonal menu puts those cheeses at the centre of sharing plates and grazing boards, with indoor and outdoor seating in a bushland setting.

Start with the cheese board, or pick up cheeses to take home. This is a cheese-focused visit: the dairy currently does not offer goat tours or goat feeding experiences. Check the operator website for current opening days and table bookings.

Pair it with a cellar door on the ridge for a Peninsula food afternoon.
whyWeGo: Farm-made goat cheeses, a seasonal menu at Billies and a quiet bushland setting.
ifOnlyOneThing: Start with the cheese grazing board at Billies.

worthKnowing.timing: Check current opening days and book a table through the dairy website.
worthKnowing.lessIdealFor: Goat tours or feeding experiences, which the dairy currently does not offer.

seasonalNotes.autumn: The farm setting is at its best when the paddocks are green and the weather turns. One of the quieter Peninsula stops in the cooler months.
seasonalNotes.winter: Fireplace lunches and quieter roads make this one of the better cold-weather Peninsula stops. Pair with a cellar door on the ridge.
seasonalNotes.spring: The seasonal menu at Billies keeps the focus on farm-made goat cheeses. Goat tours and feeding experiences are not currently offered.
seasonalNotes.summer: Choose a cheese grazing board or seasonal sharing dishes at Billies, or take cheeses home. Check the current menu before visiting.
